hmdb220571.title: The Del Valle Family Home
hmdb220571.passage: In 1839, Antonio Del Valle received Rancho San Francisco, a 48,000-acre Mexican land grant. Antonio's son Ygnacio inherited the land after his father's death in 1841. Ygnacio began construction on a small, four-room, single story dwelling in 1853 for the majordomo (foreman) who worked for him.
